2014_spells.sleet-storm.description: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused. The ground in the area is covered with slick ice, making it difficult terrain. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it falls prone. If a creature is concentrating in the spell's area, the creature must make a successful constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or lose concentration.
2014_spells.sleet-storm.effectSummary: Make a target prone until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.sleet-storm.fullDescription: Using 1 action, until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; If a creature is concentrating in the spell's area, the creature must make a successful constitution saving throw against your spell save spell save DC or lose concentration. Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
